card.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
card.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now we've learned not to need one contract.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.

mechanism: A recasts a lost bakery contract and its loan consequence as precisely needed lessons in detachment.
confusable: Unlike generic optimism, each loss must be declared necessary for growth.
comparison: D113-a calls equipment insecurity a second lesson; D113-b accepts losing A's own mug as a needed lesson too.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
